statement: The duration rung for the amended E2 twelve-seed re-run, chosen ONCE from the new excluded smoke calibration (macOS arm64), BEFORE any experimental seed was run in this re-run. Written by hand after the smoke and before the ensemble. It may never be changed once experimental data exists.
why_this_rung: The smoke (1 seed x 2 arms x 18000 ticks) took 5.4 s of ensemble time; the ensemble is exactly 12x that tick work, about 65 s, against a registered ceiling of 90 minutes. Nothing had to be given up.
not_repeated_from_the_original_lock: The original lock recorded a 24-process cross-process reproducibility acceptance. That was not repeated here; cross-process identity on this platform is instead checked by the two --replay runs after the ensemble.

build.git_tree_dirty_at_smoke_run: true, only because the smoke run's own untracked outputs were the change

commands.never: cargo run is forbidden; the example is built and its compiled binary executed directly
